survey: A tall, straight-sided glass of orange drink, seen from the front and slightly above. It stands on a purple table, with a thick glass base and a contact shadow underneath. Ice: one cube floats at the surface near the rim, and four more are packed in the upper and middle part of the drink, overlapping each other. A pink bendy straw has its bent end above the glass on the upper left. It enters at the left rim and runs diagonally through the drink, behind and between the cubes, ending near the bottom on the right. A cocktail umbrella sticks out at the upper right: the canopy is tilted toward the viewer with a white tip on top, and its wooden stick runs down and to the left from under the canopy, over the right rim and into the drink. Bubbles rise in the lower part of the drink.
